What's a spicule?

What it isTiny CICA spicules in a watery serum. Smaller than a grain of sand.
Vs. squeezingSebaceous filaments are oil and dead skin sitting in the pore opening. Everyone has them. Squeeze them and they fill right back up.The spicules peel away the dead skin around the pore as you tap, so your nose looks smoother.

How to shoot it

These are talking points, not a script. Say it your way.
1Show us your nose
  • Flash close-ups of your nose in an inset.The more examples you show, the stronger the hook.
  • Put it on screen as text: BLACKHEADS ✕ SEBACEOUS FILAMENTS ✓
Must say ⭐ "those aren't blackheads. they're sebaceous filaments"
2That's why strips don't work
  • Show what you used to do.Pore strips, scraping, squeezing.
  • They're sebaceous filaments, so pore strips and scraping can't get rid of them. ⭐
"that's why pore strips and scrapers can't get rid of them""I used to pull these out every week. they just came back"
3Tap on the spicule serum
  • Pat the Korean spicule serum over your nose and chin.
  • Then say what it does. The spicules gently peel away the dead skin around your pores, so your nose looks smoother.
"this is the only thing I changed"
4Show the After
  • Same light, same angle as your first shot.
  • Run a finger over your nose and chin.
  • Mention "save this before you squeeze again"
